```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Bash chunks are a record of commands you ran in the Terminal. Knitting shows
# them but doesn't run them again.
knitr::opts_hooks$set(engine = function(options) {
  if (options$engine == "bash") options$eval <- FALSE
  options
})
```

<!--
Explain what this step does and why, and copy each command you ran into a
bash chunk. R chunks run from the top of the repository.
-->

Taxonomic classification of the most complete bins, following the CheckM quality assessment, were classified using `GTDB-Tk.` Commands for this step were run from the `gtdbtk/` directory. 

To prepare the genomes for classification, the list of bins retained during the CheckM assessment were used to copy the corresponding genome FASTA files into the `GTDB-Tk` input directory:
```{bash}
while read bin;do echo $bin;done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

while read bin;do echo "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa";done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

while read bin;do cp "../metabat/bins_bbd/${bin}.fa" genomes;done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

`GTDB-Tk` was run using the slurm script `run_gtdbtk.sh` within `/gtdbtk`, and the output was confirmed and moved from the output directory into the main `gtdbtl/` directory for further analysis: 
```{bash}
sbatch run_gtdbtk.sh

ls -l out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv

cp out/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv .
```
